theme: Early-autumn larder: an olive-oil bean conserva and a slow-roasted tomato-fennel sugo as the week's two building blocks (2 adults - girls with Jen).

components.name: Olive-oil braised white bean conserva with confit garlic
components.time: ~90 min, mostly hands-off (soak the beans Fri night)
components.ingredients: 1 lb dried cannellini (soaked overnight), 1 head garlic, fresh sage + rosemary, 2 bay leaves, chili flakes, ~1.5 cups EVOO, salt
components.method: Drain the soaked beans, cover generously with water in a heavy pot. Add the whole peeled garlic cloves, herb sprigs, bay, a big pinch of chili and a generous pour of EVOO so a slick sits on top. Bring to a bare tremble and hold there - never a hard boil, which splits the skins - for 60-90 min until creamy, salting once tender. Cool in their own silky brodo. Keep beans + broth together; the broth is liquid gold for the week.

components.name: Slow-roasted tomato-fennel sugo
components.ingredients: 2 fennel bulbs (sliced), 2 lbs plum/cherry tomatoes (or 2 cans San Marzano), 2 shallots, 5-6 garlic cloves, EVOO, pinch sugar, chili, splash white wine, salt
components.method: Toss fennel, halved tomatoes, sliced shallot and smashed garlic with a heavy glug of EVOO, salt, chili and a pinch of sugar on a sheet pan. Roast at 375F for 50-60 min, stirring once, until fennel is soft and tomatoes are jammy and blistered. Scrape into a pot, deglaze the pan with a splash of white wine, crush lightly with a spoon. Keep slightly chunky - it's a base, not a smooth passata.

dinners.name: Pasta e fagioli
dinners.ingredients: bean conserva + its brodo, ditalini, rosemary, chili, parmesan, EVOO
steps: Warm a ladle of beans with plenty of their brodo, a rosemary sprig and chili in a wide pan.
Boil ditalini until just shy of done; move it into the beans with a splash of pasta water.
Simmer 3-4 min so the starch thickens the broth to a loose stew.
Finish off heat with grated parmesan and a hard pour of raw EVOO; crack of pepper.

dinners.name: Crisp-skin cod over brothy white beans and greens
dinners.ingredients: 2 cod (or branzino) fillets skin-on, bean conserva + brodo, escarole or lacinato kale, garlic, lemon, EVOO
steps: Pat fish skin bone-dry, salt it, let sit 10 min while beans warm with their brodo.
Wilt torn greens with a little garlic into the beans; keep brothy.
Sear fish skin-side down in a hot pan, pressing flat 3-4 min until the skin is crisp and releases, flip for 1 min.
Spoon beans and greens into bowls, set fish on top, finish with lemon and raw EVOO.

dinners.name: Shellfish brodetto in tomato-fennel sugo
dinners.ingredients: tomato-fennel sugo, 1 lb clams, 1/2 lb shrimp, white wine, parsley, grilled bread
steps: Loosen the sugo in a wide pot with a splash of wine and a little water to a brothy stew.
Add scrubbed clams, cover, steam 4-5 min until they open.
Slip in the shrimp for the last 2-3 min just until pink.
Shower with parsley and EVOO; serve with EVOO-rubbed grilled bread for the broth.

dinners.name: Rigatoni with tomato-fennel sugo and ricotta
dinners.ingredients: tomato-fennel sugo, rigatoni, fresh ricotta, parmesan, basil or parsley, EVOO
steps: Warm the sugo and loosen with a little pasta water.
Boil rigatoni to al dente and toss into the sugo over heat for a minute to marry.
Off heat, fold through spoonfuls of ricotta so it streaks rather than melts fully.
Finish with parmesan, torn herbs and a thread of EVOO.

technique.name: Pan-searing fish for crisp skin
technique.tiedTo: The crisp-skin cod over white beans - dry the skin hard, salt it, start in a genuinely hot pan skin-down and press flat so it doesn't curl, then leave it alone until it releases on its own before flipping. That release is your doneness cue for the skin.

shopping.items: 2 fennel bulbs, 2 lbs plum or cherry tomatoes, 2 shallots, 2 heads garlic, escarole or lacinato kale, 2 lemons, fresh parsley, basil, fresh rosemary, fresh sage
2 cod or branzino fillets (skin-on), 1 lb clams, 1/2 lb shrimp
1 lb dried cannellini beans, ditalini, rigatoni, 2 bay leaves, chili flakes, EVOO (stock up), white wine, crusty bread, canned San Marzano tomatoes (backup if fresh look poor)

scaleNote: This week is 2 adults (girls with Jen, Oct 4-17), so quantities are built for two with leftovers. For a full-house week of 6, double both components (2 lbs beans, double the sheet-pan sugo across two trays), stretch the pasta dishes with extra noodles rather than more sauce, and for the fish night swap clams/shrimp for a mild flaky white fish the girls like and serve fish-over-beans family style with lots of bread.
